title: MZ Doll and robot parts for the MZ generator

posts.author: Moolian
posts.body:
Here are some alternative parts for the kid body, all of which have visible joints like a doll or robot.
The first set has bleeding eyes.
The second set has eyes that are empty (or glowing depending on what color you choose).
The third has fully glowing eyes and glowing circles on the forehead and back of the head.
